download.authorization: none; do not forward the API Bearer header

content.text: <CHARACTER_MOTION_PROMPT: preserve identity and costume, return to the opening pose, no text, no speech or music>

input.ratio_warning: For first/last image-to-video the image determines aspect ratio; API ratio is adaptive. Passing 16:9 is ignored. Supply matching 16:9 images.

loop.same_image_first_and_last: Proposed production request using the documented first_frame/last_frame roles; no explicit duplicate-image prohibition was found. Actual acceptance is untested.
loop.loop_seed_fps_or_mute_controls: Not documented in the H3 create schema. Do not invent fields.
loop.reference_mix: first_frame/last_frame cannot be combined with any reference_image/reference_video/reference_audio

audio.native_audio: H3 supports audio-video generation. This task does not establish a silent-generation API option.
audio.production_policy: Prompt asks for silence; inspect downloaded streams and remove any audio before game integration.

response.download_url_expiry: Time-limited; promptly download. Query again for a new URL after expiry.

pricing.failure_billing: H3 pay-as-you-go failure/refund rules not confirmed. The no-points rule in Video Packages does not establish H3 refund rules.
pricing.retry: No documented create idempotency control. No automatic POST retry, including timeout/unknown response. Explicit new take is a new paid task.

unknowns: Account access and balance; no real API calls made
Exact 768P pixel dimensions and frame rate
Same-image first/last real acceptance and temporal seam quality
H3 pay-as-you-go failed task refund policy

cli.dependencies: Python standard library; ffprobe for image/output verification
cli.submit: submit --first-frame INPUT.png --prompt-file motion.txt --state-dir /tmp/sts2-motion-v02/h3-jobs --duration 8 (last frame defaults to the same file)
cli.dry_run: submit ... --dry-run (no key loading, no HTTP POST)
cli.status: status --job JOB.json [--wait] (GET only; resume existing task)
cli.download: download --job JOB.json --output TAKE.mp4 (GET status again, GET signed output URL without API auth, ffprobe and SHA-256 receipt)
cli.safety: Durable fingerprint reservation before POST; lock during mutation; persist only whitelisted status/code/metadata; no API key/base64/raw response/media URLs.
cli.attempt_control: --take-id take-01; an explicit new ID permits a new paid request. Always reuse one state-dir.
cli.attach: attach --job JOB.json --task-id OPERATOR_RECOVERED_ID (GET only; operator must identify correspondence)
cli.limitations: Local keyframe files only; request uses adaptive image ratio and requires matching 16:9 dimensions. Duplicate prevention is scoped to a persistent state-dir/fingerprint/take. No automatic POST retries, model fallbacks, audio stripping, PCK or game operations.
